name_review.method: Source-supported name review using government river-network maps, monitoring locations and supplied geometry. No exact spatial overlay with authoritative vector hydrography was available. River/Khola/Nadi are retained as source-used names or aliases, not assigned from river size.
name_review.geometry_changes: Two original features split into four, yielding 41 features. All original vertices retained. First junction inserted into Tokha line; lower Tokha endpoint connected to the second junction. Mahadev/Bishnumati line split at an existing vertex.
name_review.original_labels: original_name retains exact source labels; section retains capitalized source section labels without silently correcting uncertain spelling.
name_review.integration: name and river are identical display names. Update evidence CSV river values or use verified aliases for matching. Review-required labels are explicit and are not verified river names.
